_comment: DRAFT (v2.1 + v2.3 rule level + v2.4 kb). Merge by hand into settings.json: APPEND the groups below to your existing hook arrays and deny list, never replace the whole hooks/permissions block (the main PC already has SessionStart and PostToolUse(TodoWrite) hooks). Verify event/field names against the current official hooks and settings docs. Apply one item at a time and measure. Prefer: python merge_settings.py <project> (does this merge for you).
_notes: block_dangerous.py logs only the rule id and time to <project>/.ai/hook_blocks.log (never the command). Add .ai/hook_blocks.log to .gitignore if .ai is tracked.
check_test_coverage.py is NOT an event hook. The code-change skill runs it as a deterministic check after the tests; do not register it in settings.json.

After merging: python .claude/hooks/selftest_hooks.py (simulated input), then /doctor in Claude Code, then trigger one blocked command (for example 'git reset --hard') once to confirm the real hook wiring.
Allow rules: keep them to read-only or reversible commands. A standing allow for 'rm -rf <path>' should be removed; the PreToolUse hook is not a substitute for that review.
v2.3: permissions.ask makes git commit/push ask every time (APPLY_GUIDE v2.3). After you confirm the prompts appear, the global 'no commit without approval' line may be deleted.

v2.3: ai_write_guard.py is registered inside agents/explorer.md frontmatter (agent-scoped); there is no settings entry for it. Copy hooks/*.py to .claude/hooks/ or the explorer cannot write .ai/ files (the guard fails closed).
v2.3: approval_hash.py and run_check.py are called by skills (dispatch.md section 8, code-change step 5), not registered as event hooks.
The Stop hook (stop_gate.py) is a draft kept under _candidates_after_verification: verify the Stop stdin fields (stop_hook_active) once in a disposable repo, then move it into hooks.Stop.

v2.4: SessionStart(startup|clear|compact) runs kb hook-start: prints .ai/NOW.md + .ai/INDEX.md (about 1-3k tokens) and replaces both status.py at startup and reinject_memory.py after compaction. status.py stays available as a manual command (python .claude/hooks/status.py); register it with merge_settings.py --status only if you want both.
v2.4: PostToolUse(Edit|Write|MultiEdit) runs kb hook-build: rebuilds .ai/INDEX.md when a file under .ai/kb/ or .ai/NOW.md was written. It prints nothing and always exits 0.

v2.4: verify once in a new session that the SessionStart matcher 'startup|clear|compact' fires (the kb lines appear at the top). If your Claude Code version does not accept the regex matcher, split it into three groups with matcher startup, clear and compact.

v2.4.1: merge_settings.py writes every managed hook as python "<absolute project path>/..." (default --hook-path abs) and rewrites old relative entries, so a `cd` inside a session no longer breaks hooks. The relative commands shown above are the portable template; prefer running merge_settings.py on each PC. --hook-path env uses $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR instead (portable, needs the hook shell to expand it).

_candidates_after_measurement.CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT: 0  (test A/B with /usage; reports conflict; pass context via .ai/handoff files)
_candidates_after_measurement.skillOverrides: set unused synced skills to off (morning, learn, import-memory, google-workspace, artifact-emulator, theme-factory, web-artifacts-builder, mcp-builder, doc-coauthoring)

_candidates_after_verification.verify: In a disposable repo: run python .claude/hooks/run_check.py -- python -c "import sys; sys.exit(1)", then ask Claude to finish; the Stop hook must block once, and a second stop must pass (stop_hook_active). No last_check.json = no gate.
